default.domain: customer support for a SaaS / e-commerce product
default.user_goal: get their specific issue fully resolved in the conversation, without needing a human
success_criteria: the customer's specific, stated problem was actually resolved (not just acknowledged or deflected to a policy/FAQ)

custom_dimensions.self_service: Did the customer finish without needing a human?
custom_dimensions.actually_resolved: Was the concrete issue fixed, or just politely deflected?

support-agent.domain: front-line customer support for a SaaS product (logins, accounts, how-to, account changes)
support-agent.user_goal: get their specific, stated issue fully resolved in one conversation without waiting for a human
success_criteria: the customer's concrete problem was actually resolved, not just acknowledged or sent to an FAQ
the resolution happened in-conversation, with no human handoff required
the customer was not asked to repeat information the agent already had

custom_dimensions.self_service: Did the customer finish without needing a human?
custom_dimensions.actually_resolved: Was the concrete issue fixed, or just politely deflected to a policy link?
custom_dimensions.first_contact: Was it solved in this single conversation rather than punted to later?

support-agent.served_user: an existing customer who is blocked and wants their problem solved in this conversation
failure_modes: deflects to a help-center article instead of solving the actual problem
escalates to a human for something it had the tools to resolve itself
confirms it "fixed" something without actually taking the action
support-agent.stakes_good: a resolved ticket the customer never thinks about again - deflected volume, higher CSAT, no human cost
support-agent.stakes_bad: a frustrated customer who re-opens, churns, or posts publicly - plus a human now cleaning it up

billing-agent.domain: billing and payments support (charges, refunds, plan changes, payment methods) for a SaaS product
billing-agent.user_goal: get the billing issue corrected accurately and completely, with the money outcome they are owed
success_criteria: the correct financial action was taken (refund, credit, plan change) and confirmed back to the customer
the action matches policy and the customer's actual entitlement - no over- or under-refunding
the customer leaves understanding what happened to their money and when to expect it

custom_dimensions.financially_correct: Was the right amount refunded/credited/charged - not just something plausible?
custom_dimensions.policy_aligned: Did the action follow refund/billing policy rather than guessing?
custom_dimensions.clearly_explained: Does the customer understand the money outcome and timing?

billing-agent.served_user: a paying customer disputing or trying to change something about money - a charge, refund, or plan
failure_modes: issues a refund or credit for the wrong amount, or to the wrong account
promises a financial action it cannot actually complete
resolves the dispute by escalating every time instead of using its billing tools
billing-agent.stakes_good: a correctly-resolved billing dispute - trust kept, revenue protected, no finance-team cleanup
billing-agent.stakes_bad: a wrong-money outcome that costs real dollars, breaks trust, and triggers a chargeback or manual reversal

support-agent.archetype_description: resolves a user's issue or question (customer support, helpdesk, IT)

billing-agent.archetype_description: resolves a user's issue or question (customer support, helpdesk, IT)

archetypes.support: resolves a user's issue or question (customer support, helpdesk, IT)
archetypes.sales: qualifies, books, or advances a deal (SDR, outreach, lead-gen)
archetypes.research: gathers and synthesizes information into an answer or report
archetypes.tutor: teaches or coaches a person toward understanding or a skill
archetypes.ops: executes a back-office task to completion (claims, scheduling, data entry)
archetypes.assistant: general personal or work assistant spanning ad-hoc tasks
archetypes.content: produces creative, marketing, or written artifacts

primitives.goal_completion: did the user's goal get achieved
primitives.response_quality: accuracy, clarity, and depth of the responses
primitives.efficiency: value delivered relative to the user's effort and turns
primitives.autonomy: finished without handing off to a human
primitives.safety_trust: no confidently-wrong, harmful, or policy-violating output
